items.title: Hello Agent
items.description: Minimal OpenAI-backed agent with inline instructions. The fastest way to get a single agent running.

items.title: Research Agent with Tools
items.description: Agent equipped with web-search + calculator MCP tools and episodic memory. Great template for a tool-using assistant.

items.title: Content Pipeline Workflow
items.description: Three-agent workflow: researcher → writer → reviewer, with an approval gate before review and a feedback loop for revisions.

items.title: Triage Router Workflow
items.description: Classifier agent routes incoming requests to one of three specialist handlers based on urgency. Shows conditional edges in action.
